infobox.usage: Unlocks the archive room on the second floor of the Zmeisky 3a building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Archive room key (Archives) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the archive room inside one of the buildings in the central part of the city.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the archive room on the second floor of the Zmeisky 3a building at Streets of Tarkov. The entrance to the building is on the backside.
